evidence_note: Test-only. Issue #2307 asked for an abandoned ai-devops branch to be landed. One of its two commits added an opt-in terminal VERDICT line to bin/ai-codex-review because codex looked like a dead provider. run-governed-review.mjs resolves the codex report with lines.at(-1), so that change would have made every codex review refuse with 'the codex wrapper final line is not a published report path'. Nothing named the hazard. This adds the naming regression test, plus a second test pinning all three codexReportPath refusals to their own messages so the regression cannot drift onto a different failure -- the answering commit for the durable reviewer refusal recorded against head 848c14ce. Production code is untouched. The still-valid half of that branch, the ai-glm doctor fallback, is popcre/ai-devops#358. The following evidence-only commit changes only .agent files.

checks.evidence: 47 tests pass, 0 fail, including 'issue 2307: a verdict line appended after the codex report path breaks the round' and 'issue 2307: the appended-verdict refusal is distinct from the other two'.

assumptions_resolved: Confirmed on current main that run-governed-review.mjs codexReportPath reads lines.at(-1) and throws 'not a published report path' for anything else, so a trailing verdict line is fatal rather than ignored.

Confirmed the ai-devops commit 644341f5 appends that line after 'printf %s
 "$OUT"', and it is deliberately not recovered.
